title: Weekly sync — serving-runtime / infra / console — agenda + action items (2026-06-15)
content:
Quick notes / prep for 2026-06-15 weekly sync (serving-runtime + infra + console)

Primary goal: 30m sync to align on outages/incidents, perf regressions, rollouts, and console rollouts. Come with short updates — this doc is my personal prep scratchpad, will copy into shared agenda if anything new.

Attendees (ask to confirm): Evan (me), Priya, Miguel, Aisha, SRE on-call (TBD), Console PM (Lina), Release eng (optional)

Objectives:
- Surface any active incidents or customer-facing degradations
- Confirm rollout timeline for canary of kernel-select optimizer
- Action-item triage and owners for next week

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick status / incidents (5m) — everyone
   - Current: two customer reports of tokenization mismatch in GPT-compat model variant. Triage ticket JIRA-4321 (linked above).
   - Action: Priya to list reproduction steps and impacted customers by EOD 6/15.

2) Performance digest (7m) — Miguel
   - Metrics to call out: P50/P95 generation latency, tokens/sec, queue depth, GPU utilization.
   - Recent observation: P95 up ~18% for long-context workloads since kernel-select roll. Need to confirm if due to sequence-length distribution or kernel fallback.
   - Action: Miguel to run perf profile on 6/16 and post flamegraphs to /perf Slack. Due 6/16.

3) Canary rollout plan — kernel-select optimizer (7m) — Evan + Release Eng
   - Current plan: canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> 50% over 48h with auto-rollback on 3% error spike or 20% latency regressions.
   - Console change: expose toggle in rollout page and add tracing links. Lina: can you confirm UX?
   - Action: Release Eng to provision canary capacity and add monitoring dashboards (alerts + SLO rhythm) by 6/17. Owner: Raj.
   - Action: Lina to add the console toggle + docs by 6/16 (short doc + screenshot).

4) Observability gaps / tracing (5m) — Aisha
   - Missing trace for cross-region fallback path (noticed in incident logs). Traces drop at request router -> backend handoff.
   - Action: Aisha to open a tracing instrument ticket (JIRA-4350) and add a small sampling probe in router by 6/18.

5) Action-item review & blockers (5m) — everyone
   - Quick pass through open actions — mark blockers and escalate if needed.

Notes / prep items for me (Evan):
- Pull the last 7d P95 traces and filter by model family for discussion. (TODO: 6/15 morning)
- Prepare 1-slide risk summary for kernel-select canary (focusing on customer impact and rollback plan).
- Confirm on-call availability for staged rollouts (ask SRE leads).

Open questions / parking lot:
- Should we add an automated golden-test (small prompt set) that runs on every kernel-select build? Pros: early regression detection. Cons: CI duration increases. Miguel to estimate cost/benefit.
- Long-term: how to integrate quantization-profile changes into rollout pipeline? Parking for product discussion.

Action items (tracked)
- Priya: list repro steps + impacted customers for tokenization mismatch (JIRA-4321). Due: 2026-06-15. Status: assigned.
- Miguel: perf profiling + flamegraphs, post to /perf Slack and attach links to JIRA-4360. Due: 2026-06-16. Status: assigned.
- Raj (Release Eng): provision canary capacity + dashboards for kernel-select rollout. Due: 2026-06-17. Status: blocked (waiting on quota approval).
- Lina (Console PM): add toggle + short docs/screenshots to console rollout page. Due: 2026-06-16. Status: in_progress.
- Aisha: tracing instrument ticket JIRA-4350 + sampling probe in router. Due: 2026-06-18. Status: assigned.
- Evan: slide + risk summary for canary. Due: 2026-06-15 (before sync). Status: in_progress.

Follow-ups from last week (quick):
- Load-test infra change (shards -> dynamic batching): Miguel reported 10% throughput improvement in internal tests; still validating across models.
- Canary rollback drill: completed dry-run, notes in confluence link above.

Prep checklist before copying to shared agenda:
- [ ] Confirm SRE on-call name and ping them to join the sync
- [ ] Update PR links and dashboard links in linked_artifacts
- [ ] Quick sanity run of P95 generators to ensure numbers are reproducible

Parking lot items to add to next bi-weekly deep-dive:
- Deep dive: kernel selection heuristics + simulation results (30m)
- Deep dive: KV cache consistency across multi-tenant workloads (30m)

Personal notes / scratchpad thoughts:
- If kernel-select causes non-deterministic regressions, consider keeping legacy kernel build as fallback variant with same model weight checksum to avoid behavioral drift.
- Might be worth a small A/B with beta customers before wide rollout.

-- end of prep scratchpad --
